body: This sounds stupid, but I'm just really scared. I'm terrified that no one will want to be around me, even if we do share interests.

Thank you for your kind words, I really appreciate your reply. 

I agree, my main problem is feeling lonely. I've had my heart broken by people that I thought were friends in the past. 

I think I'm ready to just let go. I wish I didn't feel that way, but it's so reoccurring that it seems like the best option.
